items.title: Suno Says Jason Isbell Lawsuit Over Artist 'Identities' Must Be Dismissed: 'Nothing Unlawful About That'
items.excerpt: Suno filed a motion to dismiss Jason Isbell's class action alleging the AI music platform stole the artistic identities of Isbell and other artists, arguing there is 'nothing unlawful' about letting users prompt for an artist's style.

items.title: iZotope Photon is a local stem separation and denoising tool that runs off your GPU
items.excerpt: iZotope has launched Photon, an AI-powered stem separation and audio cleanup tool powered by 12 custom-trained models that processes audio locally on the GPU instead of uploading files to the cloud.

items.title: iZotope launches Photon, the company's first plugin developed with new owner Boris FX
items.excerpt: Photon is a standalone app and ARA plugin offering 12 machine-learning models for demixing music into stems, splitting drum kits and denoising dialogue; it is iZotope's first product built with new owner Boris FX.

items.title: Music industry intervenes in Open AI's big legal battle with newspapers and authors
items.excerpt: RIAA, NMPA, A2IM, SONA and ARA filed an amicus brief in the authors' and newspapers' case against OpenAI, setting out why AI training should never be fair use - the same question that decides the labels' suits against Suno, Udio and Anthropic.

items.title: 10 of the 45 new 'idol' groups in South Korea this year are virtual
items.excerpt: Music Ally picks up the Seoul Music Forum stat that one in four new K-pop acts in 2026 is virtual, as AI-driven virtual idols move from novelty into the mainstream debut pipeline.

items.title: A&R startup Acaply wants to help producers easily source vocals
items.excerpt: With voice cloning letting singers' voices be copied without permission, startup Acaply pitches a platform for producers to source licensed vocals from real singers.

items.title: Disney has fought AI firms over copyright. Now it's testing AI lyric videos.
items.excerpt: Disney is working with AI startup OpenArt to conceptualize lyric videos, starting with 'Go the Distance' from Hercules - a test of generative video on its own music catalog.

items.title: Is Spotify's Anti-Spam Crackdown Catching Legitimate Music in the Crossfire?
items.excerpt: 11A founder Austin Staubus says Spotify's systems to curb AI-driven slop may be overcorrecting: follower growth fell across 50 monitored bot-free playlists, 22 of which reversed or lost followers.

items.title: Number 1 on iTunes: AI Christian Rock Song 'Tell Me, How is Heaven?' Made on Suno Platform
items.excerpt: The No. 1 song on the US iTunes chart is a faith-themed track about grief by a fake 'artist', made on Suno - AI-generated music reaching the top of a download chart.

items.title: Slop Till You Drop: A Peek at the iTunes U.S. Top 10
items.excerpt: The Nov. 1 iTunes U.S. Top 10 had four tracks seemingly made with AI aid, including the No. 1 'Tell Me, How Is Heaven' by May the Lord Studio; HITS listened through to map where AI ends and human music-making begins.

items.title: 1위 A2O는 AI로 소통·뒤쫓는 2위는 AI곡…K팝에 인공지능 물결
items.excerpt: 올가을 음원 차트 1위 A2O 라이트는 AI 팬 소통 앱을 쓰고, 2위는 AI 가수 머무르의 곡이다. 제작부터 팬 소통까지 K팝 전반에 AI가 번지는 흐름을 짚었다.

items.title: "매끄러운 보컬" 차트까지 점령한 AI 음악…창작 생태계는 위축 우려
items.excerpt: AI를 활용한 노래가 국내 음원차트 2위에 올랐다. AI 음악 감상 의향은 33.7%로 늘었지만 저작권과 무단 학습 소송 문제가 남아 있다.

items.title: 리센느 제치고 AI 음원이 음원 차트 톱…美·EU 자체 기준 마련하는데 韓은 관망만
items.excerpt: 생성형 AI 음악이 국내 차트 최상위권에 진입하면서 플랫폼의 AI 음악 관리 체계가 과제로 떠올랐다. 해외 플랫폼은 표기·추천 제한 기준을 마련하는데 국내는 관망 중이다.

items.title: 기성곡 대신 'AI 음악'… 자영업자들의 새로운 선곡법
items.excerpt: 카페와 헬스장 등에서 저작권료 부담을 줄이려고 AI로 만든 음악을 매장 배경음악으로 쓰는 사례가 늘고 있다.

items.title: 음원 플랫폼, 'AI 음악' 솎아내는 기술 '문제'있다?
items.excerpt: 음원 플랫폼들이 AI 생성곡과 저품질·스팸 음원을 추천목록에서 배제하는 기술을 두고 정확도와 기준을 둘러싼 논란이 커지고 있다.

items.title: Seoul Music Forum explores humanism in AI age, with one in four K-pop acts now virtual
items.excerpt: The 2026 Seoul Music Forum examined AI's rise in music, citing that one in four new K-pop acts this year is virtual and debating what it means for labels and creators.

items.title: Tamber 2.0 Review: "This suite is exactly the kind of thing we've been waiting to see"
items.excerpt: MusicTech reviews Tamber 2.0, the AI-driven sound design suite, as the answer to what AI can do for indie developers. (Seen as a candidate on 11-02 but not published.)

items.title: [인터뷰] 마르세유 감성 담은 AI 곡으로 부산까지 사로잡다…"AI 노래 잘 만드는 비결은?"
items.excerpt: 수노와 챗GPT 프롬프트로 정규 앨범을 만든 전자음악가 시릴 히메네스가 AI 곡 제작 과정과 쏟아지는 생성 음악 속 큐레이션의 역할을 설명한다.

items.title: PCDJ releases DEX 4.1 with AI beat mapping and smarter track selection
items.excerpt: PCDJ's DEX 4.1 DJ, video-mixing and karaoke software for Windows and Mac adds AI-powered beat mapping and smarter track selection. Press release (off-list; AI DJ slot).

items.title: How Close to the Theme? Similarity-Label Conditioning for Game Music Generation
items.excerpt: Researchers fine-tune a pretrained MIDI model on Super Mario section pairs with similarity labels, so composers can control how close each generated section stays to an original theme - from near repetition to new material.

items.title: Text-to-music Generation via Structured Captions and Interpretable Evaluation
items.excerpt: Proposes training latent diffusion/flow text-to-music models on structured captions (SCAPs) rather than free-form text, with controlled ablations on coverage and temporal text information.
